answer: Payouts stay clawback-able for twelve epochs: every reward enters an escrow canyon that closes only after the key survives one random falcon sweep of a past epoch. If a sweep finds a rubber-stamped grade, the whole funding cluster forfeits every payout received in that window, not just its 400 POA bond, and its auditors lose a 100 POA holdback. Honest keys withdraw in full at epoch thirteen. Fifty clones must keep 50,000 POA of earned rewards exposed while posting 20,000 in bonds. Each karst layer of the ledger holds prior payouts in escrow, so a farm cannot hide the profit it must return.
